Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
David Cherryholmes wrote:
> On Mon, 7 Jul 2003, LSJ wrote:
>>Maris's ability functions as designed.
>
> And thus endeth the discussion. I'm gonna make that dart board for you
> one of these days, Scott.

?

You attempted to derive a reason for Maris to receive errata based on
an incorrect assumption as to why Tusk received errata.

I attempted to correct that assumption: Tusk received errata not because
the card text as written led to a power imbalance, but because it didn't
function as intended (and also contrary to intuition).

Since Maris functions as intended (and follows intuition), the fact that
Tusk received errata isn't a foundation upon which to build a case for
errata'ing Maris.

If you wish Maris to be errata'ed, demonstrate the need to errata him.

So whence the dart board comment?


